'''Kain''' (Japanese: '''ケイン''' ''Cane'') is a recurring character who first appeared in ''[[AG057|Going for a Spinda!]]''.

==History==
==={{aniseries|RS}}===
Kain became [[Claire]]'s fiancé after the pair met in a flower field. Kain is a Pokémon adventurer who travels the world in search of rare Pokémon. As a result, he had to leave, but he left his {{p|Spinda}} in Claire's care as a sign of his devotion to her. 

Kain eventually returned and reunited with Claire at the place where they first met after Spinda ran away. He attempted to battle {{TRT}}, but Spinda's {{m|Hypnosis}} was reflected back at it and it was subsequently captured. Thanks to {{an|Brock}}'s Pokémon, Team Rocket was defeated and Spinda was returned to him and Claire.

==={{aniseries|JN}}===
Kain appeared again in ''[[JN118|Battling as Hard as Stone!]]'', watching {{an|Steven Stone|Steven}} and {{Ash}}'s [[Masters Eight Tournament]] battle on [[television]].
{{-}}
